name: LC-50 laser cannon
description: The LC-50 laser cannon was a model of laser cannon that could be equipped to starships. In 3 ABY, the Trailblazer, an EML-850 light freighter, was equipped with a LC-50 laser cannon when the thief Kay Vess stole it from the Imperial Security Bureau Director Sliro Barsha's Westhill Palace in the city of Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica.
